---
title: "Fairfax Self-Parody Alert"
date: "2009-12-23"
categories: ["Media"]
---

The Sydney Morning Herald runs an op-ed by [Fidel Castro](http://www.smh.com.au/opinion/politics/copenhagen-the-moment-of-truth-20091222-lb3l.html "Fidel Castro"), titled ‘The Truth About Copenhagen’.  You can also read it in the [Tehran Times](http://www.tehrantimes.com/index_View.asp?code=210432 "Tehran Times").
